title: ML match response
$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 — The Laravel/ML boundary contract. The PHP suite validates the FAKE client's responses against this file; the Python suite validates the REAL service's responses against the same file. That is the only thing stopping a test double drifting from the service it stands in for — the classic failure mode of a mocked boundary, where every test passes and production breaks.

normalised_text.description: The query after Arabic normalisation. Returned so the caller can store what was actually matched on.

action.description: What the caller should do. Never silently auto-resolve on anything else.

reason.description: Human-readable justification, shown to reviewers. A bare score gives a reviewer nothing to act on.

semantic_score.description: Cosine similarity, so legitimately negative. Zero means the semantic signal did not run.

confidence.description: Calibrated probability the top match is correct. Not the same as fused_score.

model_version.description: Recorded against every resolution so a change in matching behaviour is traceable.

calibrated.description: Whether confidence came from a fitted calibrator. False means confidence is deliberately shrunk toward 0.5 and an auto-resolve threshold means less than it appears to.
